fields.name: fullName
fields.label: Full Name of Applicant
fields.prompt: What is your full name as it appears on your Aadhaar card?

validation.errorMessage: Name should contain only letters and be between 3 and 50 characters long.

fields.name: fatherHusbandName
fields.label: Father's or Husband's Name
fields.prompt: What is the name of your Father or Husband?

validation.errorMessage: Father's/Husband's name should contain only letters and be between 3 and 50 characters.

fields.name: dob
fields.label: Date of Birth
fields.prompt: What is your date of birth? (Please specify in DD/MM/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD format)

validation.errorMessage: Please provide a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

fields.name: address
fields.label: Permanent Address
fields.prompt: What is your complete residential address (including pincode)?

validation.errorMessage: Address should be detailed (at least 10 characters long).

fields.name: annualIncome
fields.label: Annual Family Income (INR)
fields.prompt: What is the total annual income of your family from all sources combined?

validation.errorMessage: Please enter a valid numeric income (e.g. 150000).

fields.name: incomeSource
fields.label: Primary Source of Income
fields.prompt: What is the primary source of this income? (Salary, Business, Agriculture, Pension, Wage Work, or Other)

fields.name: purpose
fields.label: Purpose of Certificate
fields.prompt: Why are you applying for this certificate? (e.g. Education, Scholarship, Welfare Scheme, Bank Loan)

validation.errorMessage: Purpose must be described in 3 to 100 characters.
